name: The Hilton Honors American Express Business Card

localized_names.en: The Hilton Honors American Express Business Card

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: $0 introductory annual fee for the first year, then $195. Offer ends 7/29/26.

apr.notes: Prime Rate + 12.74% to Prime Rate + 21.74%, based on creditworthiness. Variable APRs will not exceed 29.99%. Cash Advance APR: Prime Rate + 21.99% (28.74%). Penalty APR: Prime Rate + 25.99% (29.99%). Variable APRs are accurate as of 07/24/2026.

credit_required.notes: Not explicitly stated; Amex business cards typically require good to excellent credit.

base_rate.description: 3X on non-Hilton purchases after first $100,000 per calendar year

categories.label: All other purchases (first $100,000 per calendar year)

rewards.redemption_notes: Points are Hilton Honors Bonus Points, redeemable through the Hilton Honors program for hotel stays, experiences, and more. Bonus Points do not count toward elite tier qualification.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 130,000 Hilton Honors Bonus Points after spending $8,000 on eligible purchases in first 6 months. Offer ends 7/29/26.

benefits.title: $240 Hilton Credit
benefits.description: Up to $60 in statement credits each calendar quarter (up to $240/year) for eligible purchases charged directly with a property in the Hilton portfolio. Booking must be made directly through Hilton. Incidental charges must be charged to room and paid with card.

benefits.title: Complimentary Hilton Honors Gold Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Hilton Honors Gold status. Includes fifth night free on reward stays, daily food-and-beverage credit, and space-available room upgrades.

benefits.title: Hilton Honors Diamond Status Upgrade
benefits.description: Upgrade to Hilton Honors Diamond status if total eligible purchases reach $40,000 or more in a calendar year.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees from American Express.

benefits.title: National Car Rental Emerald Club Executive Status
benefits.description: Basic Card Members can enroll in National Car Rental Emerald Club to access Executive status. Enrollment required through American Express online account.

benefits.title: Baggage Insurance Plan
benefits.description: Coverage for lost, damaged, or stolen baggage when purchasing Common Carrier Vehicle tickets on an Eligible Card. Underwritten by AMEX Assurance Company.

benefits.title: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Coverage for damage or theft of a rental vehicle when using Eligible Card to reserve and pay for the entire rental and declining CDW. Underwritten by AMEX Assurance Company.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty
benefits.description: Terms of the Original Manufacturer's Warranty can be extended up to one additional year. Underwritten by AMEX Assurance Company.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Protects covered purchases against theft, accidental damage, or loss for up to 90 days from purchase date. Underwritten by AMEX Assurance Company.

travel_perks.hotel_status: Hilton Honors Gold (complimentary); Diamond upgrade at $40,000 annual spend
other: Up to $240/year in Hilton statement credits
